name: Travel Planner by Gildhart
changelog:
• The plugin updates itself, as a plugin from wordpress.org does. Its header names Gildhart's public updates file (Update URI), WordPress (5.8 and later) is offered each new version there, with each month's guidance, and installs it by itself; Travel Planner > Settings > Updates can turn that off, and says when WordPress on the site installs nothing by itself. Only a zip in Gildhart's updates repository, for exactly the version named, is ever offered. "View details" in Plugins shows the version's notes.
  • Settings, prices and notices are kept across an update, as they always were: they live in the site's database and the theme, never in the plugin's folder.
  • tools/publish_update.py writes a release into the updates repository; the release workflow runs it when a version is released.
